script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Call game:ai.stateSnippet.HpRateTransition.helper.updateEveryFrame with (arg).
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let v be this state → countup-snippet → get with (arg, "currBattlePhaseTurn").
If executer has the INVINCIBLE status and v is more than 2, then executer uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageId: 2127170103}], [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: [the INVINCIBLE status]}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
